about.title: Fewer pieces, worn more often
about.lead: Plainfold makes the clothes you reach for every morning — and makes them well enough to last.
paras: We started with one question: why do most basic tees go thin and shapeless after ten washes? So we went heavier on the cotton, pre-shrunk every piece and tested the fit on real people in real weather.
Everything is designed for Malaysian days — breathable outside, warm enough for air-con inside.
values: Every size tested on real bodies, with honest fit notes.
Wrong size? We'll swap it, free.
Order before 2pm, out the door today.
